command_line:
set -eu
cat > prepare_lists.R <<'RSCRIPT'
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
infile <- args[[1]]
res <- readRDS(infile)
df <- as.data.frame(res)
df$rowname <- rownames(df)
required <- c('rowname','log2FoldChange','padj')
missing <- setdiff(required, colnames(df))
if (length(missing) > 0) stop(paste('missing columns:', paste(missing, collapse=',')))
background <- df$rowname[!is.na(df$rowname) & df$rowname != '']
foreground <- df$rowname[!is.na(df$padj) & !is.na(df$log2FoldChange) & df$padj <= 0.05 & abs(df$log2FoldChange) >= 1.5 & df$log2FoldChange > 0]
write.table(data.frame(gene=foreground), file='foreground.tsv', sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, col.names=TRUE)
write.table(data.frame(gene=background), file='background.tsv', sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, col.names=TRUE)
write.table(data.frame(metric=c('foreground_genes','background_genes'), value=c(length(foreground), length(background))), file='summary.tsv', sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, col.names=TRUE)
RSCRIPT
